note: Fictional writings made up by the team for the demo. Not from any real user.

writings.text: Started the new semester today, my timetable looks okay and I bought a new notebook.
Anyone know a good place for cheap noodles near campus? I am tired of the mess food.
I missed the first quiz because I overslept. My fault really, I should have set an alarm.
Group project meeting went badly. I feel like I always slow everyone down and they would be better without me.
Can't sleep again. My parents called and we argued about grades for an hour, I hate being at home in my head.
Nobody in my hostel even noticed I stayed in my room all weekend. I feel invisible.
I keep trying to study but nothing changes, I always fail anyway. What is the point of trying.
I just feel empty most days. I lie in bed and scroll and don't feel anything.
Everything I do ruins things for the people around me. I am such a failure.
Haven't talked to anyone in days. My dad screamed at me on the phone again. I can't do this anymore.
